name: Juroku Financial Group,Inc.
summary: Juroku Financial Group,Inc. provides banking and leasing products and services in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Banking and Leasing. The Banking segment is involved in deposit-taking and loan, securities trading, securities investment, domestic and foreign exchange, corporate bond trusteeship, financial derivatives trading, and other related activities, as well as provides services as a regional financial partner and provides credit guaranty services. The Lease segment offers leasing services.
